findings.title: Task brief passed as argv to claude subprocess — visible on process list
findings.detail: defaultHaikuCall in auto-router.ts passed the full router prompt (which includes the user-supplied task brief) as a positional CLI argument after --print. On Linux this is visible to all local users via /proc/<pid>/cmdline and ps aux. Task briefs routinely contain proprietary business context and repo details that should not be world-readable on a shared VPS.
findings.fix_sketch: Changed from execFile with argv prompt to spawn with stdin piping (stdio: ['pipe','pipe','pipe']). Prompt written to child.stdin and stdin closed synchronously before the child's read loop starts, avoiding the no-stdin-data warning.
findings.fix_summary: Replaced execFile argv-based prompt passing with spawn + stdin piping in defaultHaikuCall (src/classifier/auto-router.ts). Import changed from execFile to spawn; prompt now written to proc.stdin and stdin closed synchronously. All 969 tests pass; typecheck and lint clean. (AUDIT-IFleet-824d213b)
